capabilities: Export named fenced code blocks as new files in a vault folder
Preview target paths, full output text and rejected blocks before writing
Join blocks with the same target path into one file in note order
Reject unsafe paths and conflicting or existing targets
Save output folder profiles and generate an export index (Pro)
extras: Freemium: folder profiles and export index require a paid Pro check via GitHub Sponsors sign-in (device flow, read:user scope only). After minor/major updates it opens a promo tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+; rejects sources over 2 MiB and caps at 100 targets; multi-file exports are not atomic; mobile and non-macOS platforms untested per the FAQ.
problem: Obsidian code blocks stay embedded in notes; there is no built-in way to turn named fences into actual files on disk beside those notes.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once) for Pro features
GitHub account sign-in for Pro features

summary: Code fence exporter that writes named code blocks (file="...") from the active note to new files in a chosen vault folder, with a preview step.
